applies_to.quote: These Directions shall be applicable to Commercial Banks (hereinafter collectively referred to as 'banks' and individually as a 'bank').

answer.action: Commercial banks must calculate CVA risk capital requirements and make required Pillar 3 disclosures under the new framework.
answer.action_quote: A bank shall calculate the capital requirements for Credit Valuation Adjustment (CVA) risk on a standalone basis for all covered transactions in both banking book and trading book.

effective_date.quote: These Directions shall come into effect from April 1, 2027.
